create_vasp_relax_inputs: run the CLI to generate VASP relaxation input files from a directory of CIF structure files
create_vasp_static_inputs: run the CLI with type static to generate VASP static calculation input files from CIF files
create_input_generator_relax: create a RelaxSetGenerator with custom INCAR settings loaded from a YAML file for VASP relaxation
create_input_generator_static: create a StaticSetGenerator with custom INCAR settings loaded from a YAML file for VASP static calculations
review_create_input_generator: review the create_input_generator function that loads INCAR YAML settings and returns a RelaxSetGenerator or StaticSetGenerator
